name: Bloom
look: a slender white-spotted fawn with huge dark eyes and tiny antler buds from which small flower blossoms grow
temperament: Shy and trusting; it follows her barefoot through the grass and flowers open where it steps
scenePlacement: standing close at her side among the flowers, head raised toward her
notes: Test-bed creature for Angel Primes; never a dragon (the Elder Dragons are the Drakn line). Use it to try creature art, then move what works into the main roster.
